heapOrArchives.title: ACME Savings and Loan
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Rezzing ACME S&L costs 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. When you rez ACME S&L, gain [12] and trash ACME S&L. rig.title: Highlighter
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Highlighter counter. Each Highlighter counter after the first allows you to access an additional card from R&D whenever you access cards from R&D. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.
